name: Slag tortoise
description: a big slow tortoise of the Ember Wastes, the Magma King's tollkeeper: a thick cracked shell of cooled black slag covering its front like a wall, glowing orange lava between the shell's plates, a bare soft dark red back half, stumpy legs, an old wrinkled head with a glowing mouth

poses.stand: standing on its four stumpy legs side-on, head out, the slag shell's front plate raised
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

move.action: plods slowly forward on its stumpy legs, the shell rocking, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: stretches its neck out and spits a slow glowing ember forward to the right from its mouth

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
